reasoning_content: mapserv needs the `map` CGI variable. Let me set MS_MAP_FILE correctly (it's a CGI variable called "map").

action.command:
export PGHOST=localhost PGPORT=5432 PGUSER=xplanbox PGPASSWORD=xplanbox PGDATABASE=xplanbox
source /opt/mapserver/env.sh
export QUERY_STRING="map=/opt/mapserver/mapserver.map&request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1" REQUEST_METHOD=GET SERVER_PROTOCOL="HTTP/1.1" HTTP_HOST="localhost" REMOTE_ADDR=127.0.0.1
timeout 30 mapserv 2>&1 | head -c 500
